summary: Iteration 3 Mobile UX testing complete. All mobile responsive features working correctly: Login/Register pages have no horizontal scroll with contained watermarks, Dashboard hamburger menu opens drawer with all nav items, ResponsiveTable component renders expandable cards on mobile and tables on desktop, Admin Dashboard KPI grid shows 2 columns on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: ResponsiveTable component is well-designed with proper mobile/desktop breakpoints using hidden md:block and md:hidden classes
Framer-motion drawer animation is smooth with proper overlay backdrop
Watermark sizing using min(480px, 90vw) effectively prevents horizontal overflow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 mobile UX fixes verified. Key components: DashboardLayout.js (hamburger + framer-motion drawer), ResponsiveTable.js (shared component for mobile cards/desktop tables). All admin tables (Users, Transactions, Promos) use ResponsiveTable. AdminDashboard and MarketingDashboard have inline mobile card lists. Login/Register watermarks use min() sizing. Regression tests confirm iteration 1 & 2 features still work.
